title: LEVER: Adaptive Cost-Aware Proof Search Over AND/OR Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.11862v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mathematicians value proofs for more than correctness: among correct proofs, simplicity, purity and the computational cost of finding them vary widely. Yet LLM-powered theorem provers largely search for any correct proof, and improve its quality only after it is found. We propose LEVER, a proof search algorithm that makes the objective over correct proofs programmable and optimizes it during search. LEVER scores partial proofs over an AND/OR proof graph, combining realized objective values with predictions for open subgoals, so the objective guides search before a proof is complete. The same mechanism optimizes computational cost, proof length, topical impurity, and even their weighted combinations, while the Lean kernel enforces correctness. translated_title: LEVER：基于AND/OR图的自适应成本感知证明搜索
translated_abstract: 数学家重视证明不仅仅在于正确性：在正确的证明中，简洁性、纯粹性以及找到它们的计算成本差异很大。然而，基于大语言模型（LLM）的定理证明器主要是在搜索任意正确的证明，并且只有在找到证明之后才去改进其质量。我们提出了LEVER，一种证明搜索算法，它使得针对正确证明的优化目标可以被编程定义，并在搜索过程中对其进行优化。LEVER在AND/OR证明图上对部分证明进行评分，将已实现的目标值与对未解决子目标的预测相结合，从而让目标在证明尚未完成时就能引导搜索方向。同一机制可以优化计算成本、证明长度、主题不纯度，甚至它们的加权组合，同时由Lean内核确保正确性。在Lean 4环境下的PutnamBench上，在匹配的计算预算下，LEVER比一个强大的单会话智能体节省了34%的成本，同时将解决率从80%提高到96%。在减少主题不纯度方面，即……（摘要原文截断）
tldr: LEVER提出了一种在AND/OR证明图上对部分证明进行评分的自适应成本感知证明搜索算法，使正确证明的优化目标（如计算成本、证明长度、主题纯度等）可编程并在搜索过程中被优化，在PutnamBench上以节省34%的成本将解决率从80%提升至96%。
en_tdlr: LEVER is an adaptive cost-aware proof search algorithm that scores partial proofs over an AND/OR proof graph, making the objective over correct proofs programmable and optimizing it during search, which on PutnamBench reduces cost by 34% while raising the solve rate from 80% to 96%.
